description: You are hosting a birthday karaoke party for Alex. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/karaoke_queue.xlsx. Review the party scenario file at /home/ga/Documents/party_scenario.txt which lists all song requests. Organize these requests into a fair queue system with columns for: Queue Position, Singer Name, Song Title, Length (min), Status, and Running Time. Ensure Alex (birthday person) gets priority placement for their 2 songs in the top 4 positions. Implement fair rotation so people requesting 2nd songs only go after all first-timers have performed. Add formulas to calculate running times. The venue closes in 90 minutes! Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
